items.title: Cohomology of a module sheaf on the fppf site agrees with the cohomology of its small-site restriction
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file descent.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: For a sheaf of modules G on the big fppf site of a scheme S which is quasi-coherent on the small site and invariant under pullback along flat locally finitely presented morphisms, the lemma shows that the cohomology of G on a flat locally finitely presented U agrees with the cohomology of its small-site restriction (statement lines 4056-4070). The proof is a comparison of two short exact sequences: the author pulls back the small-site restriction to the big site to get a quasi-coherent F together with a comparison map which is an isomorphism on every small site of a flat locally finitely presented morphism, by the two hypotheses, and therefore has parasitic kernel and cokernel for the fppf topology (proof lines 4072-4089). The parasitic cohomology lemma makes the comparison map an isomorphism on cohomology, and the known result for the quasi-coherent F finishes (proof lines 4089-4095). The claim is H2: the notion of parasitic sheaves and the reduction to the quasi-coherent case are both cited, but the construction of the comparison map and the check that its kernel and cokernel are parasitic are written out in the span.
